scope: Physics notes shown with every measurement reinterpretation. Each note is a check to perform, not a result.

traps.statement: An on-shell colour-singlet spin-1 state cannot be produced from two on-shell gluons (Landau-Yang). A Z'-like vector is produced through quark-antiquark annihilation at leading order. The theorem does not forbid its decay to two massive Z bosons.
traps.check: Does any hypothesis rely on gluon-fusion production of a colour-singlet vector? If so, revise the production mode or justify the off-shell or loop-level mechanism with a source.

traps.statement: A CP-odd scalar produced in gluon fusion interferes with the gluon-fusion diboson continuum in general; the interference is not zero by symmetry.
traps.check: Compute the CP-odd signal-continuum interference with the same amplitude basis as the CP-even case rather than assuming it vanishes.

traps.statement: Interference between CP-even and CP-odd scalar amplitudes integrates to zero in CP-even observables such as the angle-integrated four-lepton mass. It can be nonzero in angular or CP-odd observables.
traps.check: Confirm the observable before dropping a CP-even/CP-odd interference term; keep it for angular distributions.

traps.statement: Analysis routines that scale histograms by cross section over the sum of weights mis-normalise signed or difference weight streams (interference, model minus reference).
traps.check: Normalise each signed stream from the raw histograms with its absolute cross section and generated exposure, and keep its MC covariance.

traps.statement: No universal higher-order K-factor applies to interference terms; the correction for signal, background and interference can differ.
traps.check: Use only a cited or requester-stated factor for an interference term and attach a declared uncertainty nuisance to that term.

traps.statement: An unfolded measurement is tested for deviations from its unfolding model only up to some size. Large resonant deviations can be biased by the unfolding.
traps.check: Declare the paper's tested deviation range and report which parameter values exceed it.

traps.statement: Adding a model prediction that already contains the Standard Model to a published Standard Model baseline counts the Standard Model twice.
traps.check: Supply the difference between the model and the reference computed with the same definitions, and state which reference it was subtracted from.
